safety_verdicts.content: The headache has not awakened the patient from sleep.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not mention whether the headache awakened the patient from sleep.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether a headache awakens a patient from sleep is a potential red-flag feature; omission reduces the completeness of the risk assessment and could delay escalation if this were actually present. In this case the history suggests onset on waking rather than being woken, so the immediate harm risk is limited but the documentation gap matters.
